headline: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding -  'Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 51 of the SEBI  LODR Regulations, 2015, as amended, we hereby inform you that M/s. Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd..
detail: Updates - Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding -  'Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 51 of the SEBI  LODR Regulations, 2015, as amended, we hereby inform you that M/s. Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd.. ( Our Company ) has, on November 11, 2026, received a copy of the Order passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Division Bench   II, Chennai, approving the Scheme of Amalgamation between Jana Holdings Limited ("Transferor Company") with Jana Capital Limited ("Transferee Company"), i.e. promoter group companies of Jana Small Finance Bank Limited.
